name: Hex Key Set (Allen Wrenches)
description: Set of small L-shaped black steel rods with six-sided tips, in graduated sizes on a folding holder. Used to tighten the bolts that come with flat-pack furniture and bicycles.

name: 16 oz Claw Hammer
description: Steel-headed hammer with a flat striking face and a curved, forked claw on the back for pulling nails. Yellow and black rubber grip.

name: Rubber Mallet
description: Hammer with a soft, black cylindrical rubber head and a wooden handle. Taps pieces together without denting or marking the surface.

name: 25 ft Tape Measure
description: Palm-sized yellow square case holding a retractable, curved metal ruler blade with a hook on the end and a thumb lock.

name: 24 in Spirit Level
description: Long red aluminum bar with small glass tubes of green liquid, each with an air bubble that centers when a surface is perfectly flat or upright.

name: Needle-Nose Pliers
description: Pliers with long, thin, pointed jaws for gripping and bending wire in tight spaces. Red cushioned handles with a built-in wire cutter.

name: 10 in Adjustable Wrench
description: Silver chrome wrench with a sliding jaw moved by a small thumb wheel, so one tool fits many sizes of nuts and bolts.

name: Phillips Screwdriver #2
description: Screwdriver with a cross-shaped, plus-sign tip and a blue cushioned handle. Fits the most common household screws.

name: Flathead Screwdriver
description: Screwdriver with a single flat, wedge-shaped tip for slotted screws. Clear amber handle. Also handy for prying open paint can lids.

name: Retractable Utility Knife
description: Orange handheld box cutter with a razor blade that slides out of the handle and locks. Cuts cardboard, carpet, drywall, and old caulk.

name: 20V Cordless Drill/Driver
description: Pistol-shaped, battery-powered teal and black power tool with a trigger and a spinning chuck. Drills holes and drives screws. Includes battery and charger.

name: 21-Piece Drill Bit Set
description: Case of gold-colored spiral metal bits in graduated thicknesses that fit into a drill to bore holes in wood, metal, and plastic.

name: Electronic Stud Finder
description: Handheld yellow sensor you slide flat along a wall; it beeps and lights up when it passes over the hidden wooden framing behind the drywall.

name: 4 in C-Clamp
description: Heavy C-shaped cast iron frame with a long threaded screw and T-handle. Squeezes two pieces together while glue dries.

name: 3 in Putty Knife
description: Flat, wide, flexible metal blade on a short handle, like a small spatula. Spreads wall filler and scrapes off old paint.

name: 12 in Hacksaw
description: Hand saw with a D-shaped metal frame holding a thin, fine-toothed blade under tension. Cuts metal pipe, bolts, and plastic tubing.

name: Plastic Drywall Anchors (50 pack)
description: Small ribbed plastic sleeves, blue and yellow, shaped like tapered cones. Push one into a hole in the wall and it expands to grip when a screw goes in, so the screw doesn't pull out of hollow walls.

name: Assorted Wood Screws (200 pack)
description: Compartment box of gold-colored screws with sharp points and coarse threads in several lengths, for joining wood.

name: Cable Ties (100 pack)
description: Thin black nylon strips with a ridged tail that threads through a small square head and locks tight in one direction. Bundles cords or fastens almost anything.

name: Duct Tape, 60 yd
description: Wide roll of strong, silver-gray cloth-backed sticky tape that tears by hand. The fix-anything tape.

name: Multi-Purpose Lubricant Spray
description: Aerosol can with a thin red straw nozzle. Stops squeaky door hinges, loosens rusted or stuck bolts, and displaces moisture.

name: Wood Glue, 8 oz
description: Squeeze bottle of thick, pale yellow glue with a twist-open tip. Bonds wood joints stronger than the wood itself.

name: Super Glue (2 pack)
description: Tiny tubes of clear, instant-bonding liquid adhesive that sets in seconds. Repairs ceramics, plastic, and metal.

name: Picture Hanging Kit
description: Assortment of small brass hooks with angled nails, braided wire, and sawtooth hangers for putting frames and mirrors on a wall.

name: Felt Furniture Pads (48 pack)
description: Soft, round brown stick-on discs for the bottoms of chair and table legs. Stops furniture from scratching hardwood floors and makes it slide quietly.

name: Rubber Door Stop Wedge
description: Brown rubber triangle-shaped wedge that slides under a door to hold it open or keep it from slamming.

name: Steel S-Hooks (10 pack)
description: Metal hooks bent into an S shape. One end hangs over a rod or shelf, the other holds pots, plants, or tools.

name: Bungee Cords (6 pack)
description: Stretchy, brightly colored elastic ropes with a metal hook on each end. Straps down loads on a cart, bike rack, or truck bed.

name: Toilet Plunger
description: Red rubber suction cup on the end of a wooden stick. Pushes and pulls to clear a clogged toilet or sink drain.

name: Thread Seal Tape (3 rolls)
description: Very thin, stretchy, non-sticky white tape on a small spool. Wraps around the threads of pipes and shower heads so the connection doesn't leak.

name: Drain Clog Remover Tool
description: Long, flexible plastic strip with tiny barbs along the sides. Slides down a sink or shower drain and pulls out clumps of hair.

name: Faucet Aerator
description: Small round chrome ring with a fine mesh screen inside that screws onto the tip of a sink faucet. Makes the water stream smooth and stops splashing.

name: 14 in Pipe Wrench
description: Heavy red iron wrench with toothed, adjustable jaws that bite into round pipes and fittings to turn them.

name: Caulk Gun
description: Metal half-barrel frame with a trigger and a push rod. Holds a tube of sealant and squeezes it out in a steady bead.

name: Kitchen & Bath Silicone Caulk, White
description: Long tube of white, waterproof, rubbery sealant with a pointed nozzle. Fills the gap around bathtubs, sinks, and showers and resists mold.

name: Universal Toilet Flapper
description: Round red rubber flap with a chain that sits at the bottom of the toilet tank. Replacing it fixes a toilet that keeps running.

name: 25 ft Outdoor Extension Cord
description: Long, thick, bright orange power cable with a plug on one end and a socket on the other. Reaches outlets that are too far away.

name: 6-Outlet Surge Protector
description: White rectangular bar with a row of six sockets, a lighted on/off switch, and a cord. Turns one wall outlet into many and guards electronics against power spikes.

name: Wire Stripper & Cutter
description: Plier-like tool with a row of notched holes in the jaws, each sized to cut and pull the plastic coating off electrical wire without nicking the copper.

name: Non-Contact Voltage Tester
description: Pen-shaped yellow gadget with a plastic tip that glows red and beeps when held near a live wire or outlet. Checks whether the power is really off.

name: LED Light Bulbs, Warm White (4 pack)
description: Standard pear-shaped screw-in bulbs that give a soft warm white glow, use little energy, and last for years.

name: Wire Connectors (100 pack)
description: Little cone-shaped plastic caps in orange, yellow, and red with a metal spring inside. Twist one over the bare ends of wires to join them safely.

name: Electrical Tape, Black
description: Narrow roll of stretchy, shiny black vinyl tape that insulates and wraps around wire connections.

name: Outlet Safety Plugs (24 pack)
description: Clear plastic caps with two prongs that push into unused wall sockets so babies and toddlers can't stick fingers or objects inside.

name: AA Alkaline Batteries (20 pack)
description: Pack of standard finger-sized cylindrical batteries for remotes, toys, clocks, and flashlights.

name: LED Flashlight
description: Black aluminum tube with a bright white LED beam and a click button on the tail. Water resistant; runs on AA batteries.

name: LED Headlamp
description: Small light on a stretchy elastic strap worn around the forehead, leaving both hands free to work in the dark, under a sink, or in an attic.

name: Painter's Tape, 1.5 in
description: Roll of blue paper masking tape that peels off cleanly without pulling up paint. Protects trim, ceilings, and edges for crisp lines.

name: 9 in Paint Roller with Cover
description: Fluffy white fabric cylinder that spins on a wire frame with a handle. Rolls paint across walls and ceilings fast and evenly.

name: Paint Tray
description: Shallow rectangular plastic pan with a deep well at one end and a ribbed, sloped ramp for loading a roller and rolling off extra paint.

name: 2 in Angled Paint Brush
description: Paint brush with soft bristles cut on a slant and a wooden handle. Paints neat lines along trim, corners, and ceilings.

name: Canvas Drop Cloth, 9 x 12 ft
description: Large, heavy beige fabric sheet spread over floors and furniture to catch paint drips, spills, and dust.

name: Assorted Sandpaper (20 sheets)
description: Stiff brown paper sheets with a rough, gritty surface in coarse to fine grades. Smooths wood and scuffs surfaces before painting.

name: Sanding Sponge
description: Firm foam block coated with grit on all sides. Fits the hand and flexes to sand curved edges and patched spots on walls.

name: Lightweight Spackling Paste
description: Small tub of soft paste that goes on pink and dries white. Fills nail holes, dents, and small cracks in walls before painting.

name: Silicone Spatula
description: Flexible red heat-proof paddle on a handle that bends to scrape every last bit of batter from a bowl and won't scratch non-stick pans.

name: Balloon Whisk
description: Bulb-shaped cage of looped stainless steel wires on a handle. Beats eggs, whips cream, and stirs lumps out of sauces.

name: Stainless Steel Colander
description: Metal bowl covered in small holes, with two handles and a foot ring. Drains the water from pasta and rinses vegetables.

name: Y-Shaped Vegetable Peeler
description: Y-shaped handle with a swiveling blade across the top that shaves the skin off potatoes, carrots, and apples in thin strips.

name: Garlic Press
description: Hinged metal squeezer with a small chamber of tiny holes. Crushes a clove into a fine mince when the two handles are pressed together.

name: Bench Scraper
description: Flat rectangular sheet of stainless steel with a rolled handle along one edge. Cuts dough, scoops up chopped vegetables, and scrapes the counter clean.

name: 12 in Locking Tongs
description: Two long metal arms joined by a spring at one end, with scalloped silicone tips. Grabs and flips hot food without piercing it.

name: Rasp Grater / Zester
description: Long, narrow metal strip covered in tiny razor-sharp teeth, with a black handle. Shaves citrus peel, hard cheese, ginger, and nutmeg into fluffy shreds.

name: Manual Can Opener
description: Two-handled clamp with a small cutting wheel and a turning knob that travels around the rim of a tin to take the lid off.

name: 10 in Cast Iron Skillet
description: Heavy, thick black frying pan made from a single piece of metal. Holds heat for searing steak and goes from stovetop to oven.

name: Measuring Cups & Spoons Set
description: Nesting stainless steel scoops in graduated sizes on a ring, marked with cup and tablespoon amounts for baking.

name: Microfiber Cloths (12 pack)
description: Soft, fuzzy, brightly colored square rags that trap dust and polish glass and screens without leaving lint or streaks.

name: Window & Shower Squeegee
description: T-shaped handle with a straight rubber blade that wipes water off glass, mirrors, and shower doors in one streak-free pass.

name: Spray Bottles, 24 oz (2 pack)
description: Empty clear plastic bottles with a trigger nozzle that adjusts from fine mist to stream. Fill with cleaner or water for plants.

name: Stiff Scrub Brush
description: Palm-sized brush with a curved grip and stiff bristles for scouring tile grout, tubs, and stubborn grime.

name: Lint Roller + 2 Refills
description: Handle with a spinning roll of peel-off sticky paper sheets that picks pet hair, fuzz, and dust off clothes and couches.

name: Melamine Eraser Sponges (8 pack)
description: White foam blocks that, with just water, rub scuff marks, crayon, and fingerprints off walls, baseboards, and sneakers.

name: Reusable Rubber Gloves
description: Long yellow waterproof latex gloves that reach up the forearm. Protects hands while washing dishes or using harsh cleaners.

name: Dustpan & Brush Set
description: Small hand broom that snaps into a flat plastic scoop with a rubber lip. Sweeps up crumbs, broken glass, and small messes.

name: Garden Trowel
description: Small hand-sized shovel with a pointed, scoop-shaped metal blade and a green handle. Digs holes for planting flowers and bulbs.

name: Bypass Pruning Shears
description: Spring-loaded hand clippers with short, curved blades like heavy scissors. Snips rose stems, twigs, and small branches.

name: 50 ft Garden Hose
description: Long, flexible green rubber tube with brass screw fittings on each end that carries water from an outdoor tap.

name: Adjustable Hose Nozzle
description: Pistol-grip sprayer that screws onto the end of a hose, with a dial that changes the water pattern from gentle shower to hard jet.

name: Gardening Gloves
description: Breathable knit gloves with green rubber-coated palms and fingers that protect hands from thorns, dirt, and blisters.

name: 2 Gallon Watering Can
description: Green plastic jug with a top handle and a long spout ending in a perforated cap that sprinkles water like gentle rain on plants.

name: Jute Garden Twine, 300 ft
description: Ball of rough, natural brown string for tying tomato plants and vines to stakes and bundling cuttings.

name: Foam Kneeling Pad
description: Thick, rectangular green foam cushion with a cut-out handle. Saves the knees while weeding, planting, or scrubbing floors.

name: Binder Clips, Assorted (60 pack)
description: Black triangular spring-steel clamps with two silver wire arms that fold flat. Hold thick stacks of paper together, or close snack bags.

name: Sticky Notes, 3 x 3 in (12 pads)
description: Small square pads of pale yellow paper with a strip of light glue on the back, for reminders that stick and peel off without a mark.

name: Staple Remover
description: Little spring-loaded pincher with two pairs of curved metal fangs that slide under a staple and pull it out of paper.

name: Adhesive Cable Clips (20 pack)
description: Small black stick-on rubber holders with a slot that keeps charger cords from sliding off the desk or dangling on the floor.

name: Handheld Label Maker
description: Small device with a keyboard and tiny screen that prints words onto a strip of adhesive tape for naming bins, files, jars, and cables.

name: Mesh Desk Organizer
description: Black metal mesh caddy with compartments, a small drawer, and upright slots to hold pens, scissors, mail, and notepads.

name: Packing Tape with Dispenser
description: Wide roll of clear, strong plastic tape on a red handheld dispenser with a serrated cutting edge, for sealing shipping and moving boxes.

name: Bubble Cushioning Wrap, 30 ft
description: Roll of clear plastic sheeting covered in small air-filled pockets that pop. Wraps dishes and fragile items for shipping or moving.
